shared_elements: elongated figure with legs extending downward
justification: Both surfaces depict animal figures shown in profile with legs, rendered in a broadly schematic manner, which is a generic correspondence any tradition could produce. A shows a densely organised multi-register composition (a row of crouching quadrupeds above a banded zone, then a large-headed predator facing a small human-like figure, then a fox/canid and plant-like fronds), while B shows a single sparse elongated creature with a comb-like row of vertical strokes along its back and no register structure, human figure, or accompanying motifs.
